# pstack attribution

pstack was created by Lauren Tan and is distributed under the MIT License.
Original project: https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack

The five pstack-* skills in this pack are concise, independently adapted workflows for OpenCode. They draw on the pstack ChatGPT port version 0.2.0 available during preparation. They are not the full pstack plugin, do not install Cursor or Codex plugin machinery, and do not claim affiliation or endorsement. The original license is included here.
